elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses the greater of fees paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, subject to Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excludes Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breaches of data-protection or security obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.
Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.
Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.
Fraud is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party’s intellectual property is an Excluded Claim and therefore uncapped.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 protects only undisputed capital-F “Fees” for conforming Services; “Fees” is defined solely as the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, so other payment obligations such as subscription fees are not excluded.
